Haircare for All Your Goals

Repair bonds with OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology® for stronger hair. Incorporate OLAPLEX Nᴼ.0 Intensive Bond Building Treatment, followed by Nᴼ.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment, the new pre-shampoo treatment that’s formulated to protect and repair hair in just 3 minutes. It immediately revives all 5 key signs of hair health : strength , smoothness , softness , shine , and shape . Try a hair mask with patented OLAPLEX Bond Building Technology™ like the ￼ Weightless Nourishing Mask or the Rich Hydration Mask . Not sure which mask to choose? Reach for the Weightless Nourishing Mask if you have fine to medium hair, or try the Rich Hydration Mask if you have medium to thick hair.

Achieve the ultimate smoothness for your hair with OLAPLEX’s anti-frizz and styling solutions. Hydrate, soften, and repair hair with anti-frizz products like OLAPLEX Nᴼ.6 Bond Smoother® and Nᴼ.9 Bond Protector Nourishing Hair Serum ; see how they compare. Lock in moisture and get 72-hour frizz control and humidity resistance with OLAPLEX Nᴼ.7 Bonding Oil. Top off your curls by styling with OLAPLEX Nᴼ.10 Bond Shaper® Curl Defining Gel.

Cleanse, hydrate, and strengthen with the classic OLAPLEX Nᴼ.4 Bond Maintenance® Shampoo and Nᴼ.5 Bond Maintenance® Conditioner duo. Blondes and greys, tone with OLAPLEX Nᴼ.4P Blonde Enhancer™ Shampoo and Nᴼ.5P Blonde Enhancer™ Conditioner. For a deep cleanse, try OLAPLEX Nᴼ.4C Bond Maintenance® Clarifying Shampoo to remove impurities. Get clinically proven healthier hair in one use and immediate moisture with OLAPLEX Nᴼ.5 Leave-In Moisturize & Mend Leave-In Conditioner after washing with the shampoo and conditioner of your choosing. For fine hair , wash and condition with OLAPLEX Nᴼ.4FINE Bond Maintenance® Shampoo and Nᴼ.5FINE Bond Maintenance® Conditioner , which repair and strengthen hair while providing healthy body and volume . For curls and coils, use OLAPLEX Nᴼ.4 CURL Bond Shaper™ Hydrating Curl Shampoo and Nᴼ.5 CURL Bond Shaper™ Hydrating Curl Conditioner to gently cleanse, deeply hydrate, and define your natural texture without stripping moisture from your hair.
